purpose: Determine whether BuildOpt can learn safe generic partial-work actions from the portfolio of exact Gradle commands a customer actually repeats, rather than from one frozen request per repository.

hypothesis.input: Exact ordinary Gradle argv vectors observed through the committed wrapper, their portable request identities, adjacent source changes, finalized requested graphs and current producer output state.
hypothesis.action: Learn relevance and candidate closures independently for each recurrent request identity, then select only a previously observed request/action pair with complete current evidence.
hypothesis.safeFallback: Run the exact original optimized-native Gradle command when no recurrent identity, relevant change, complete producer state or qualified action exists.
hypothesis.materialDifference: The stopped route evaluated one fixed leaf request per repository. This route learns the distribution of commands the customer actually runs and never substitutes a broader benchmark command to manufacture relevance.
